EPT Benchmark: Evaluation of Persian Trustworthiness in Large Language Models
	


A comprehensive benchmark for assessing the trustworthiness of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Persian contexts.




	
		
		🎯 Overview
	

The EPT (Evaluation of Persian Trustworthiness) benchmark addresses a critical gap in AI trustworthiness evaluation by providing a robust framework for Persian-language contexts. As LLMs face substantial challenges including hallucination, bias perpetuation, privacy… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mirbagheri-mohammadreza/EPT-Benchmark.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for Persian trustworthiness with growing attention in Persian NLP and trustworthiness research communities.
